annotation_policy: Deterministic source-pixel samples on clearly visible static NBA court paint in the immutable native 960x540 Frame C only. The free-throw family uses only the visibly isolated solid 6-foot semicircle; pixels on the free-throw line, paint boundaries, players, ball, bodies, inferred geometry, generated pixels, and dashed/occluded circle segments are excluded. A fourth family samples the long clean paint sideline from the free-throw line toward the basket using the visible colour-boundary centreline; it is held out independently and constrains the projective root. The opposite paint sideline contributes only its clearly visible pre-occlusion segment; no pixels are inferred through players.

regulation_geometry.coordinate_system: basket-local centimetres: +X from backboard face toward court, +Y across court, Z=0 floor

notes: The prior full-circle extraction was rejected because straight paint-boundary pixels contaminated the FT-circle candidate set. This v65 input intentionally uses only the isolated visible solid FT semicircle; held-out pixels are never used in fitting. The lane-sideline sign is a basket-local +Y convention; the mirror-equivalent court orientation remains a later cross-camera alignment check and does not authorize metric promotion. The paired +/-8ft paint sidelines fix the lateral orientation rather than relying on a mirror-equivalent single-line root.
